records.name: Feldwebel Vorschriftsmäßig
records.biography_en: Can detect a regulation breach before a regulation exists. His inspection card divides HyperNorm residents into compliant and not yet inspected. A dissonant card refuses to stand in either line. The Men in Black demand a single direction; Hunky and Dory change the destination. He leaves a little room for those who cannot keep up.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Vorschrift ist eindeutig. Ihr Gegenstand wird gesucht.

variant_notes.note_en: Can detect a regulation breach before a regulation exists.

records.name: Funker Empfangsbereit
records.biography_en: Receives certainty in bursts and doubt continuously. Her headset catches conflicting HyperNorm instructions before they can be filed as agreement. She keeps a channel open for apologies. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Empfang bestätigt. Gewissheit derzeit gestört.

variant_notes.note_en: Receives certainty in bursts and doubt continuously.

records.name: Gefreiter Gleichda
records.biography_en: Attempts to look ready while wondering what ready is for. He holds a doorway beneath a blanket roll packed for immediate departure. A dissonant card asks whether staying can also be a choice. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Bereitschaft steht. Wohin, bleibt offen.

variant_notes.note_en: Attempts to look ready while wondering what ready is for.

records.name: Werkmeister Klemmtnoch
records.biography_en: Distrusts perfect machines and the people who promise them. His oil can attends to HyperNorm machinery that management calls maintenance-free. A dissonant card has begun listing the squeaks. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Fehler lässt sich reproduzieren, auch ohne Leitung.

variant_notes.note_en: Distrusts perfect machines and the people who promise them.

records.name: Sanitäterin Haltstill
records.biography_en: Issues kindness in a tone that sounds like an instruction. She wraps bandages around HyperNorm residents whose distress is marked inadmissible. Her medical bag has no compartment for that distinction. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Behandlung erfolgt unabhängig vom Vorgang.

variant_notes.note_en: Issues kindness in a tone that sounds like an instruction.

records.name: Küchenwart Nachschlag
records.biography_en: Must feed a queue that grows whenever he counts it. His ladle measures HyperNorm portions against a queue that never reaches an authorized length. A dissonant card requests seconds for somebody absent. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Nachschlag wurde vorsorglich nicht ausgeschlossen.

variant_notes.note_en: Must feed a queue that grows whenever he counts it.
